audit_questions.why_b1_in_pilot: The pilot treats each catchment calibration as an independent serial case to strictly validate per-case correctness and artifact reproducibility.
audit_questions.why_c1_in_pilot: The minimal SCEBaseline runner implements the canonical simplex update loop serially without batching the initial population or reflection/contraction candidates.

batching_scaling_evidence.findings: The compiled Torch-FUSE kernel supports any batch size N along the leading dimension [N, 8401, 3] and [N, 37]. Scaling from N=1 to N=2 gives 3.06x throughput; scaling to N=4 gives 7.03x throughput on this GPU.

combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.algorithm_semantics_impact: Zero change to SCE algorithm for initial population (evaluating all 2*P+1 initial population in 1 forward pass). For simplex reflection/contraction/random, candidates can be batched per complex.
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.batching_mode: Option 1: Candidate batching within one catchment (C candidates x 1 basin)
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.current_runtime_support: Supported directly without kernel modification (simulate_coupled_rk2_batched handles arbitrary batch size N)

combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.algorithm_semantics_impact: Requires careful lockstep synchronization across basins or masked stepping. If complex evolution diverges, active candidates per basin must be tracked.
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.batching_mode: Option 2: Multi-basin synchronized SCE batching (B basins x C candidates)
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.current_runtime_support: Supported by numerical kernel; requires multi-case scheduler orchestration in Python

combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.algorithm_semantics_impact: Zero change to science or results. The optimizer objective evaluation for the best theta already produced the exact discharge trajectory on the full 8401-day forcing. Train KGE and test KGE can be computed directly by slicing that discharge tensor without re-running 2 extra 8401-day simulations.
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.expected_speedup: 2.0x speedup per case (eliminates 50% of runtime per case)

combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.current_runtime_support: Already partially in VRAM; can be cached across cases

combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.algorithm_semantics_impact: Zero for objective (only Q is needed for KGE). Full states/fluxes retained only for final best-theta artifact.
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.batching_mode: Option 5: Lightweight simulation mode for objective (omit unused flux/state stacks)
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.current_runtime_support: Requires lightweight return mode in batched simulator
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.expected_speedup: 10% to 15% simulation speedup (avoids 38 list appends and 38 torch.stack calls per step)
combined_batching_feasibility_matrix.tensor_shapes: only q [N, 8401] accumulated, fluxes/states omitted during optimization
